question: What is the value of a² + b² + c² - 2ab - 2bc + 2ca ?
solution:
Given:

a2 + b2 + c2 - 2ab - 2bc + 2ca

Concept used:

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

Calculation:

a2 + b2 + c2 - 2ab - 2bc + 2ca

⇒ a2 + (-b)2 + c2 + 2a(-b) + 2(-b)c + 2ca

⇒ (a + (-b) + c)²

⇒ (a – b + c)2

**∴ The value of a2 + b2 + c2 - 2ab - 2bc + 2ca is (a – b + c)2.**
